title: InformationRight
description: An access grant that authorizes one specific actor to perform a listed set of operations on a single InformationEntity. The grant applies only while an attribute-based constraint expression evaluates to true at decision time. It differs from a role-assigned Permission because it names the grantee directly and carries its own qualifying condition. Use Permission instead when the grant is a reusable resource+action entitlement assigned to Roles rather than to a named actor, and has no per-grant constraint expression. Use Delegation instead when authority is transferred from one actor (delegator) to another (delegatee), possibly time-bounded, rather than granted directly on an information asset. Use NeedToKnow instead when access is gated by the actor declaring a purpose or justification rather than by an attribute-based boolean constraint. Use AccessCondition instead when the element is only the field/operator/value predicate itself, not the grant binding an actor and operations to an information asset.

actor.description: Identifier of the actor (security.actor) to whom this right is granted.

constraint.description: Boolean constraint expression that must evaluate to true for the right to apply (e.g., 'actor.department == resource.ownerDepartment').

operations.description: Permitted operations on the information entity granted by this right.

x-dr-standard: NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 AC-3(13) Attribute-Based Access Control; NIST SP 800-162 ABAC policy; STS-ml authorisation
x-dr-evidence: An ABAC policy line naming a concrete subject, data asset, actions and condition, e.g. Casbin `p, billing-svc, customer_pii, read, r.sub.region == r.obj.region`
A cloud IAM or KMS policy statement whose Principal is a specific user or service, whose Resource is a named data store or dataset, and which has an Action list and a Condition block
An OPA/Rego or Cedar `permit` rule keyed on a specific principal id and data category, with a `when`/`if` clause comparing subject attributes to resource attributes
